description: Returns a person's photo ID image (wraps NBAPI GetPicture). The response's PICTURE field is a Base64-encoded JPEG and may be very large — a full-size badge photo runs to hundreds of kilobytes of Base64 text, so prefer PICTUREURL when you only need to identify the file. The response also carries PERSONID, PICTUREURL, LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME and LASTMOD. The payload is passed through unmodified: this tool neither decodes, resizes nor truncates the Base64 string. A person with no photo answers FAIL with "No picture URL for this person ID" or "Picture file does not exist"; an oversized image answers "Person picture image file size exceeds maximum to be returned/exported".

PERSONID.description: Required. The PERSONID of the person whose picture should be retrieved.

name: get_picture
